highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.
highlights_body: It adds variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, modern sampling APIs, and new Linux and Tizen assets. Lifecycle, pixel access, font handling, and platform packaging receive substantial fixes. This is a breaking major release, so review the migrations below.

breaking.title: Legacy paint, text, sampling, run-buffer, and backend APIs are compile errors
breaking.body: Pre-v4 obsolete members are removed from the reference surface or promoted to error. Move text and glyph operations from SKPaint and SKTypeface to SKFont, pass SKSamplingOptions and SKTextAlign explicitly, use run-buffer span properties, and use backend constructors without sampleCount.

breaking.title: SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality are removed from the reference surface
breaking.body: The obsolete enums no longer compile against v4 reference assemblies. Replace them with SKFontHinting and SKSamplingOptions.

breaking.title: Default font and paint typeface semantics changed
breaking.body: A parameterless SKFont or a null typeface now produces SKTypeface.Empty, while a new or reset SKPaint exposes SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default when text must render, and use IsEmpty rather than null checks for an unset typeface.

breaking.title: Missing family names now fall back on Android
breaking.body: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns SKTypeface.Default rather than null for a missing Android family. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when strict missing-family detection is required.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside the native range
breaking.body: The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException instead of silently truncating values outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call Move(int).

breaking.title: Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1
breaking.body: Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context against Vulkan 1.0 can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to that same version; use another backend on 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: Vulkan backend interop layouts changed
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative removes fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2 where applicable. YCbCr conversion info also adds Components, so update manual struct initialization and native layout assumptions.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion info uses the GR prefix
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Migrate from the obsolete GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo shim and replace reliance on its removed value-equality interface and operators.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject disposal protection is getter-only
breaking.body: Derived wrappers can no longer assign IgnorePublicDispose. Update custom subclasses so disposal protection is established by the base wrapper lifecycle rather than mutating this property.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8 or later
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The v4 engine update drops the EOL Tizen arm and x86 builds and packages. Move deployments to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers.

bullets.detail: Advances the bundled renderer from the 3.119 baseline through m148, including newer image-codec, HDR, wide-gamut, raster, filter, and runtime-effect behavior.

bullets.lead: Bundled image, font, and compression libraries refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, FreeType to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1, and libpng to 1.6.58.

bullets.lead: Variable and color fonts gain first-class APIs
bullets.detail: Adds variation-axis discovery and cloning, color font palette queries and overrides, HarfBuzz variation controls, and the correctly ordered HBColor value type.
SKWebpEncoder can encode single images or timed frame sequences through span-based stream overloads.
SKStream.GetData returns ref-counted backing data when the native stream can provide it directly.
SKSurface.Draw, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap gain overloads that accept SKSamplingOptions explicitly.
Adds SKPathBuilder, RF16 color data, CICP color spaces, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, and shader mask filters.

bullets.lead: Pixel spans honor offsets and shared-buffer stride
bullets.detail: SKPixmap and SKBitmap now calculate coordinates and span lengths from the correct axis and RowBytes, including extracted subsets.

bullets.lead: Font span operations and glyph checks corrected
bullets.detail: Handles undersized variation buffers correctly and fixes a recursive ContainsGlyphs overload that could overflow the stack.
Preserves the current surface dimensions when a GL view is reattached after tab switches or page navigation.
Packages the native projection assembly under compatible .NET 9 and .NET 10 runtime asset paths.

bullets.lead: Apple library targets accept the base Xcode 26 workload
bullets.detail: Packages target the 26.0 platform versions instead of requiring Xcode 26.2.
Lazily initializes process-wide wrappers, prevents shared native handles from being freed, and keeps managed wrappers alive across native calls.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility checks no longer run at assembly load
bullets.detail: Defers the compatibility gate until the first native call so applications can configure their native-library resolver first.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer races its builder
bullets.detail: Prevents a finalizer-thread crash when an internal SKPathBuilder is collected before its owning path.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution is more resilient
bullets.detail: Moves default-font lookup into the managed layer, avoids Android startup crashes, and uses an empty typeface when no system font is available.

bullets.lead: NanoServer starts without a system font manager
bullets.detail: Uses an empty font manager on NanoServer instead of crashing during SKTypeface initialization.
Adds x64 and arm64 packages for Linux environments that use Android's Bionic libc.
Adds tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 packages built against Tizen 8.0.
Refreshes the bundled XML parser to 2.8.1, including upstream security hardening and entropy-source changes.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and modern C# compiler support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone upgrades, variable fonts, singleton lifecycle hardening, resilient typeface handling, and the SKPath finalizer fix
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android SKGLView rendering recovery after tab switches and navigation

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the v4 line on Skia m147 with variable and color fonts, CICP color spaces, surface sampling, refreshed PNG/XML libraries, Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets, and Android GL and typeface fixes. Tizen drops 32-bit assets; null SKFont typefaces become empty, and obsolete SKStream.Move rejects out-of-range offsets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and restores broad Xcode 26 compatibility for Apple packages.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Adds HBColor, XPS creation, per-resource GPU flushes, and shader mask filters while refreshing bundled native libraries and preventing NanoServer font initialization crashes. WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8 or later, and Vulkan YCbCr callers should migrate to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.summary: Updates to Skia m148, adds RF16 pixels, fixes pixel-span stride and offsets, hardens singleton and native-call lifecycles, restores .NET 9 WinUI loading, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.0. Legacy SKPaint text and sampling APIs become compile errors; migrate to SKFont and explicit SKSamplingOptions.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 updates the bundled shaping engine from 8.3.1.6 with improved OpenType shaping, CFF2 subsetting, and font-table handling. It also adds variable-font controls, color palette queries, HBColor, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.
